race.description: Ladbrokes Racing Extras In Multi Max 150 Points
race.comment: FLYING SAUCER (1) turned spotting a big start finishing fourth (17.89) last time in a Grade 5 at this track. Has a good record at this journey. Has won two of three starts from this draw. Has ability and looks hard to stop. SUPER (4) finished well back at this track last time when a 11 length fifth (17.95) but scored four back at this track (17.48). Likely to play a prominent role. TULLOCH ROAD (2) showed little early speed at his last couple, the latest finishing fourth (18.01) in a Grade 5 at this track. Safe beginner who has drawn to advantage. Can do much better this time. PETA ZOOM (7) cannot be written off despite a miss here at her latest outing.
